summary: The advanced_host_list inventory plugin parses comma-separated host strings with ranges, for non-path sources containing a comma.
questions: Can I pass a host range like host[1:10] on the command line with -i?
Which inventory plugin parses host ranges in -i strings?

answer_card.title: advanced_host_list inventory plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.advanced_host_list` parses a comma-separated host list string and supports **host ranges**. It only applies to inventory sources that aren't paths and contain at least one comma.
